description: This script automates the verification and validation process for BBF tools, including package installation, syntax checking, JSON validation, and running specific validation scripts on JSON plugins and data models.

methods.name: exec_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command, typically with sudo privileges, handling output and errors.

methods.name: exec_cmd_verbose
methods.description: Executes a command with verbose output for debugging purposes.

methods.name: check_ret
methods.description: Checks the return code of a previous command, exiting or handling errors if necessary.

calls: exec_cmd pip3 install jsonschema xlwt pylint
